moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description: Raises the user’s Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stat rank.

moves.name:
Guzzling
Swallow
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses Stockpile.
Deactivation Condition: When this move is used.

Restores the HP of all allied sync pairs by approximately 20% of their maximum HP. The more the user’s Defense or Sp. Def are raised, the more it also restores its HP. Removes all of the user’s Defense and Sp. Def increases.

moves.name:
Gorging
Crunch
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s Defense and Sp. Def total 6 stat ranks or higher.
Deactivation Condition: When the user’s Defense and Sp. Def total 5 stat ranks or less.

The more the user’s Defense or Sp. Def are raised, the greater the power of this attack. Lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stat rank. Removes all of the user’s Defense and Sp. Def increases.

moves.name:
Endless
Ambition!
moves.description: Raises the Attack and Sp. Atk of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Applies the Take Next "All" Move effect to the user.

passives.name: Johto Flag Bearer
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="5" ]%.)

passives.name: Giovanni’s Greed
passives.description: When a status move used by the user’s Pokémon raises its stats only, raises the same stats by the same amount for all allied sync pairs instead. When an ally’s stat is raised by a status move used by the user’s Pokémon, it is raised by three times the stat ranks. Increases the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when the user’s Pokémon uses a status move.

passives.name: B-Move: Restore T-Move MP 9
passives.description: Restores [Digit:1digit ] MP for the user’s Trainer when it uses a buddy move.

passives.name: Team Sharp Entry 3
passives.description: Raises the critical-hit rate of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit ] stat [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ] when the user enters a battle.
